result.title: Semantic Concept Steering Breaks the Explanation Drift Loop in Continual Learning
result.summary: Catastrophic forgetting in continual learning (CL) manifests not only as accuracy degradation but also as \emph{explanation drift}: models maintain predictive accuracy while silently shifting attention from diagnostic features to spurious correlations. This work identifies and resolves a previously overlooked structural flaw in explanation-aware CL: pixel-level saliency regularization derives supervision targets from the model's own frozen saliency maps, creating a \emph{self-referential drift loop} that actively reinforces spurious attention across tasks. We introduce \textbf{C$^3$L} (Concept-Consistent Continual Learning), which breaks this loop by anchoring regularization to class-consistent semantic concepts (e.g., ``curved beak'', ``striped pattern'') discovered offline, independent of model state, providing (i) target independence from model drift, and (ii) cross-instance semantic consistency across every instance of a class. We identify that our concept-based objective, combined with approximate LRP relevance conservation, induces a \emph{crowding-out effect}: since concept and background regions compete for the relevance of the same prediction, enforcing high relevance within concept regions implicitly suppresses spurious background correlations without explicit penalization. \method does not require human-annotated concept sets, as it employs a fully automated concept discovery and spatial grounding. Extensive evaluation across five benchmarks and over 20 baselines demonstrates state-of-the-art performance in accuracy, forgetting, explanation quality, spurious correlation mitigation, and out-of-distribution robustness.

AI.brief_summary: 论文指出持续学习中存在「解释漂移」——准确率维持但注意力转向虚假特征，并把原因归于像素级显著性正则用模型自身冻结的显著性图作监督所形成的自指回路；提出 C³L，用以离线自动发现、与模型状态无关的类别一致语义概念作锚定目标，并指出概念与背景争夺同一预测的 LRP relevance 会产生「挤出效应」从而抑制虚假相关。
AI.relevance_reason: 「监督目标独立于模型漂移、并为类内各实例提供一致语义锚点」这一思路，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与 latent 内容的贡献分配提供不自我强化的监督线索；其 relevance 守恒与挤出效应能否迁移到多模态推理轨迹，可供核查。
